claims.text: Mara Ibarra, who goes by the display name Mara and uses login mara-river with account ID 1847, proposed a local replay queue for HarborMesh relay nodes that would keep readings through outages without replacing the existing scheduler, as recorded in Forge issue 47 (https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh/issues/47).

She posted this idea in Forge issue 47 comment c901 on April 12, 2026; our code body responded in comment c903 that it matched our field deployments, and we agreed to prototype the replay queue in her comment c906 on April 14, 2026, as noted in the same issue.
The purpose was to create a resilient replay mechanism that could work on disconnected relay nodes, preserving sensor data during network outages while leaving the current scheduler unchanged.

By April 16, 2026 we had an active prototype of the replay adapter (tracked in docs/STATUS.md at https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh), and the April 30 HarborMesh field trial demonstrated that it correctly replayed buffered readings through an outage; however, the team paused any wider rollout on May 2, 2026 pending calibration drift investigation, and the May 3, 2026 report noted there was still no production deployment.

The supplied memories do not record whether the calibration drift was later resolved, if or when production deployment eventually happened, or any further changes to the replay prototype after May 2026.

claims.text: Mara Ibarra, who goes by the display name Mara and uses login mara-river with account ID 1847, proposed a local replay queue for HarborMesh relay nodes that would keep readings alive during outages without replacing the existing scheduler.

She posted this idea in Forge issue 47 comment c901 on April 12, 2026; our code body responded in comment c903 that it matched our field deployments, and we agreed to prototype the replay queue in her comment c906 on April 14, 2026.
The purpose was to create a resilient replay mechanism that could work on disconnected relay nodes, preserving sensor data during network outages while leaving the current scheduler unchanged.

By April 16, 2026 we had an active prototype of the replay adapter, and the April 30 HarborMesh field trial demonstrated that it correctly replayed buffered readings through an outage; however, the team paused any wider rollout on May 2, 2026 pending calibration drift investigation, and the May 3, 2026 report noted there was still no production deployment.

The supplied memories do not record whether the calibration drift was later resolved, if or when production deployment eventually happened, or any further changes to the replay prototype after May 2026.
